Method of Attack: Phishing campaign distributing remote access trojan (RAT)
Stealing passwords from web browsers and email clients
Batch issuing commands to compromised victims
Downloading additional malicious payloads (keylogger, mail credential viewer, browser credential viewer)
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious URLs, MHT, and ZIP file attachments
Indicators of Compromise: PE32 executable files camouflaged as .tar.gz archives
